description: This is a Python source file implementing a SQLite storage adapter for a vehicle telemetry and alert management system. It includes functions for schema initialization, seed sample data, CRUD operations for assets, telemetry, and alerts, as well as filtering and acknowledgment functionalities for alerts.

classes.name: SQLiteStorageAdapter
classes.description: A storage adapter implementing persistent storage using SQLite for assets, telemetry data, and alerts management including schema initialization, data insertion, querying, and alert acknowledgment.

methods.name: str _dt_to_str(dt: datetime)
methods.description: Converts a datetime object to ISO-8601 string with timezone information for storage.

methods.name: datetime _str_to_dt(value: str)
methods.description: Parses an ISO-8601 string with timezone info back into a UTC datetime object.

methods.name: None init(self)
methods.description: Creates necessary tables and applies schema updates if needed.

methods.name: list[Asset] seed_sample_assets(self)
methods.description: Seeds the database with sample asset data if no assets exist.

methods.name: Asset create_asset(self, asset_id: str, name: str, type: str)
methods.description: Inserts a new asset record into the database.

methods.name: Asset|None get_asset(self, asset_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves asset information by asset ID.

methods.name: list[Asset] list_assets(self)
methods.description: Lists all assets sorted by creation date.

methods.name: datetime|None get_latest_telemetry_timestamp(self, asset_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches the most recent telemetry timestamp for a given asset.

methods.name: list[dict[str,Any]] query_telemetry_range( self, asset_id: str, start: datetime, end: datetime, )
methods.description: Fetches telemetry records for an asset within a specified time range.

methods.name: int insert_telemetry(self, record: TelemetryRecord)
methods.description: Inserts a telemetry record for an asset.

methods.name: list[dict[str,Any]] list_telemetry( self, asset_id: str, start: datetime | None = None, end: datetime | None = None, limit: int = 500, )
methods.description: Lists telemetry records for an asset, with optional time window and limit.

methods.name: Alert create_alert(self, asset_id: str, severity: AlertSeverity, message: str)
methods.description: Creates a new alert entry for an asset.

methods.name: Alert _row_to_alert(self, r: sqlite3.Row)
methods.description: Converts a database row into an Alert domain model instance.

methods.name: tuple[list[Alert],int] list_alerts_filtered(self, flt: AlertFilter)
methods.description: Retrieves alerts based on filtering criteria with sorting and pagination.

methods.name: tuple[list[Alert],list[str]] ack_alerts( self, alert_ids: list[str], acked_by: str | None, ack_comment: str | None, )
methods.description: Marks alerts as acknowledged with optional acknowledgment details.
